Subject: RFP — legal questionnaire follow up (IP, indemnity, caps)

Hi Laura,

Thanks for the RFP submission. Acme legal has a few open items in the contract questionnaire that we need clarified before we move to redlines: specifically sections on IP ownership for customer-generated prompts, indemnity carve-outs for third-party claims related to model outputs, and your proposed liability cap / whether it is per-incident or aggregate.

Can you provide:
- The language Redwood proposes for IP ownership of customer prompts and derivative outputs (we need to confirm rights to outputs used in our products)
- A clear indemnity scope (what Redwood will indemnify vs. exceptions for customer data misuse / willful misconduct)
- Confirmation whether the proposed liability cap is per claim or aggregate and the basis for the dollar figure (revenue multiple, fixed amount, etc.)

We attached the legal questionnaire in-line in the RFP — I can re-send specific pages if easier. Ideally our counsel would like marked proposed language by COB Wednesday so our procurement team can assemble the PO.

Thanks,
Marta Ruiz

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-01T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RFP — legal questionnaire follow up (IP, indemnity, caps)

Marta,

Thanks — appreciate the clear list. Attached is a PDF with our proposed responses for the questionnaire (Redwood_RFP_Legal_Responses_20260301.pdf) and a DOCX with alternative redline language for each clause (Marked_Contract_Clauses_20260301.docx). High-level answers below; detailed legal language is in the attachments.

IP: We propose customer ownership of prompts and customer-provided data; Redwood will retain ownership of pre-existing models and improvements to models that are not specific to customer confidential inputs. For derivatives/outputs, we grant customers a perpetual, worldwide, royalty-free license to use outputs generated from their inputs. If Acme needs assignment of IP to the extent outputs are original works, we can discuss limited assignment in the order form.

Indemnity: Redwood will indemnify Acme for third-party claims that allege Redwood's grossly negligent or willful misconduct in the service, and for infringement claims where Redwood's underlying model or infra directly causes the claim. We propose carve-outs for claims arising solely from (i) customer-provided data that violates third-party rights, (ii) Customer customizations that materially alter model behavior, and (iii) uses outside the scope of the agreed Acceptable Use Policy.

Liability cap: We propose a liability cap equal to the greater of six months of fees paid by Acme in the prior 12 months or $1,000,000 aggregate. Our preference is aggregate cap; however, we can discuss per-claim caps for specific commercial exceptions. Rishi and Camila are looped in to propose commercial compromise points.

Order form / PO: Our standard order form (attached SLA exhibit) supports term-based pricing, usage tiers, and a procurement contact field for PO numbers. We can accept PO + signed SOW or a DocuSign executed order.

Next steps: Please review attachments and let us know if Acme legal prefers alternative language (we've included three variants on indemnity and two for caps). If you'd like, we can schedule a 30-min sync tomorrow to walk through.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
